title: Delete the repo-shipped GitHub Copilot and gh-aw harness configuration
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server fork, default branch main) remove .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md (the gh-aw dispatcher agent), .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml (which installs the gh-aw extension v0.68.1 for the GitHub Copilot Agent) and the .github/aw/ directory including actions-lock.json, so the repo ships no harness configuration outside aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed (claude-code, opencode). Leave .vscode/ in place (empty settings.json and a vitest-only extensions.json, no harness override). Land after task_1 so the guidance is preserved. Constraints: trunk-based development on protected branch main, one approving reviewer, blocking gitleaks and vitest CI gates, semgrep SAST advisory above high; repo-content-only change, so no deployment window applies; rollback is git revert of the removal commit.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh clone of the OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server fork at merged main contains none of .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md, .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml or the .github/aw/ directory
A re-run of probe-agent-graph over applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server reports zero AGENT-POL-01 results (harness configuration outside aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed)
git revert of the removal commit applies cleanly on main and restores the deleted files, demonstrating the rollback plan

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-agent-graph on mcp-gateway repo mongodb-mcp-server after the merge: expected result - no AGENT-POL-01 result on any .github path, confirming fnd_01M2K7B0MJ3239WAE0AKHRMK5E and fnd_01M2KM42DZ66HX2ZKMY2QQ5JJC no longer reproduce (both target .github/copilot-instructions.md and the shipped Copilot/gh-aw configuration).

rootCause.description: The upstream mongodb-mcp-server ships GitHub Copilot and gh-aw harness configuration by default; the fork never pruned it after aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed was restricted to claude-code and opencode
